findings.description: Direct inspection of all six V199 pose renders shows that the 30 mm inner front-lap drop does not resolve crouch and sit failure: the front panels still lift into rigid triangular flaps in crouch and separate around the thighs in sit, exposing under-shorts and much of the anterior thighs. The added authored length is visible, but it does not provide stable pose coverage.

The front, back, three-quarter, neutral, and arms-up renders still read as a broad apron with coarse, crushed vertical folds rather than a finished short pleated overskirt. The longer inner hem leaves the same unfinished silhouette and does not create clean pleat structure.

Direct left and right views show long, narrow front-lap tails projecting well below and away from the side skirt silhouette, with abrupt transitions to the shorter outer and back hem. They look detached from the intended short overskirt silhouette.
The five main views still show angular/faceted jacket torso patches and a lumpy, uneven waist transition.

nextAction: Keep V199 rejected and retain its source, pose envelope, and weights as the current checkpoint. For V200, redesign the front skirt-panel division and hem continuity so the central lap cannot peel into isolated tails or triangular flaps in crouch and sit; keep the waist attachment and outer side seams continuous, then rebuild and directly inspect the same five views and six poses before any acceptance claim. Do not promote a package: fit, rig/weight, Unity/VRChat runtime, and release remain unverified.
